title: Français 3198
contents: Reports on Batory, divisions among the Polish nobles, imperial diplomacy and peace with the Turks; outward friendliness conceals political hostility.

excerpt: Les Polonois **sont diuises** comme ilz estoient, et iacoit qu'ilz **monstrent bon uisage au batori aux coeurs est le contraire**, pour certain, comme j'entend non seulement dudict **uuarsauicio** mais aussi de plusieurs aultres.
translation: The Poles remain divided as before; although they show Batory a friendly face, in their hearts they feel the opposite, as I hear not only from the said Warsawicio but also from several others.

excerpt: Ledict Weber s'en est allé à Auguste pour voir une signorie qu'il ait achepté dernierement en ces quartiers là, appellée Rombals, et retournera à Vienne quand sa Majesté y sera arrivée. Il suivra encores la Court le temps de deux ans pour estre versé aux affaires d'icelle **mais** plusieurs **ne pleureroient s'il n'i** [r]**etourno**[i]**t iamais**.
translation: The said Weber has gone to Augsburg to see a lordship he recently bought in those parts, called Rombals, and will return to Vienna when His Majesty arrives there. He will continue following the court for two years to become versed in its affairs, but many would not weep if he never returned there.
